target.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Skills are copied into the sandbox workspace on every sandbox setup. For users who do not use skills or have already deployed them through other means, this sync is unnecessary overhead that slows down sandbox initialization and consumes disk space.

Related: #97638

## Why This Change Was Made

The issue requests a config toggle to skip the skills sync step. This change adds skipSkillsSync as an optional boolean under agents.defaults.sandbox and agents.list[].sandbox, defaulting to false (preserving existing behavior).

## User Impact

Users can now opt out of skill sync with:

```json5
{
  agents: {
    defaults: {
      sandbox: {
        skipSkillsSync: true,
      },
    },
  },
}
```

## Evidence

**Before (existing test, unchanged):** requests-skill-sync-for-read-only-sandbox-workspaces — syncSkillsToWorkspace IS called when skipSkillsSync is absent (false by default).

**After (new test 1):** skips-skill-sync-when-skipSkillsSync-is-enabled-with-read-only-workspace — syncSkillsToWorkspaceMock is NOT called when workspaceAccess=ro and skipSkillsSync=true.

**After (new test 2):** skips-skill-sync-when-skipSkillsSync-is-enabled-with-writable-workspace — syncSkillsToWorkspaceMock is NOT called when workspaceAccess=rw and skipSkillsSync=true.
